macros.name: crnb
macros.doc: \crnb, which expands to \cr\noalign{\par\nobreak}, to prevent a page break between a heading and the remainder of the table which follows.

macros.name: crs
macros.doc: The macro \crs and command key crskip are provided to assist in fine tuning the vertical spacing inside an alignment.

macros.name: defineglwlevels
macros.doc: \defineglwlevels \glb and \glc are given definitions in expex.tex by the command \defineglwlevels{b,c}. The command also creates the parameters everyglb, everyglc, aboveglbskip, and aboveglcskip. everyglb and everyglc are initialized to empty token lists and aboveglbskip and aboveglcskip to 0 pt.

macros.name: deftag
macros.doc: After \deftag{ reference }{ tag } is executed, \getref{ tag } expands to reference, where the value of the reference is determined at the point the \deftag command was evaluated.

macros.name: deftagex
macros.doc: \deftagex{ tag } expands to \deftag{\the\exno}{ tag }.

macros.name: deftagpage
macros.doc: \deftagpage{ tag } expands to \deftag{\the\pageno}{ tag }, but the expansion is delayed until after Tex ’s page breaking mechanism has decided what page the \deftag command appears on.

macros.name: ex
macros.doc: The argument of \ex will be passed to \lingset and the result evaluated, so that the example will be typeset with these parameter settings.

macros.name: exbreak
macros.doc: The ExPex macro \exbreak is a variant of \goodbreak. It not only ends the current paragraph and awards a penalty (a reward if the penalty is negative) if a page break is taken at that point, but makes it easier for a satisfactory page break to be taken by allowing the page to end with some vertical fill, allowing some whitespace to appear at the bottom of the broken page.

macros.name: exdisplay
macros.doc: \exdisplay is designed to accommodate an unboxed \halign.

macros.name: exnoprint
macros.doc: \exnoprint, which is how \ex inserts example numbers.

macros.name: gathertags
macros.doc: If you say \gathertags, the tag/reference pairs will be written to a file as they are established.

macros.name: gla
macros.doc: greater-than beside less-than

macros.name: hwit
macros.doc: \hwit (hidewidth italics) inserts the italicized label into the alignment in such a way that it is centered over the nonwhite portion of the column it heads.

macros.name: labels
macros.doc: \labels initializes the counter \pexcnt, which is then used to generate the labels.

macros.name: lastlabel
macros.doc: \lastlabel expands to the most recent label, in the form in which it is printed (i.e. containing the expansion of \everylabel).

macros.name: Lingset
macros.doc: \Lingset first scans its argument from left to right and sets all the parameters from the family ling.

macros.name: ljudge
macros.doc: ExPex provides the macro \ljudge which pushes the judgment diacritics into the gap between the labels and the examples, instead of pushing the examples to the right to make room for the judgment diacritics.

macros.name: nl
macros.doc: \nl abbreviates \omit\hfil, so that it can be used to prevent the appearance of a label in a cell.

macros.name: noexno
macros.doc: \noexno is provided in case the user wants to use \exdisplay for something other than a numbered example. It cancels the automatic advancement of \excnt.

macros.name: refproofing
macros.doc: If you execute \refproofing, then all the references that are generated by \bblastx, \blastx, \lastx, \nextx, \anextx, \getref, and \getfullref are highlighted.

macros.name: tl
macros.doc: \tl inserts the appropriate label, with following period, and increments the counter.
